safetyInvariants: Target-size packets allow only LIKELY_BARRIER or UNCERTAIN.
The lane has no registered v3 publication claim family in the broad-scope LLM path, so no target-size packet currently converts to an authoritative v3 judgment.
Controls and exception evidence never become clears; clearBridgeableRows remains 0.
Exception evidence is disqualifying for LIKELY_BARRIER structural readiness.
Visual screenshots are contextual for this lane; CSS-pixel geometry and explicit exception/control evidence are load-bearing.
Equivalent, essential, and user-agent-control markers are fixture-scoped control evidence, not global proof of conformance on arbitrary saved pages.

concernsCarriedForward.issue: Exception controls are partly marker-driven; inline/equivalent exceptions can override probe judgment from data-v3 markers, and essential/UA/equivalent evidence is fixture-scoped rather than real-world proof.
Representative visuals cover targetsize-p1 and targetsize-n1 through targetsize-n6 only; validation and integration artifacts cover all 20 cases.
